news.title: US threatens sanctions against Chinese AI models over IP theft
news.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. could sanction Chinese open AI models over alleged IP theft, expanding the Trump administration's campaign to slow China's AI advances.

news.title: Music streamer Deezer says more than 50% of daily uploads are AI-generated
news.description: Deezer said more than 90,000 AI-generated tracks were uploaded daily on the platform in June.

news.title: Anthropic’s landmark $1.5B copyright settlement is approved
news.description: The final approval settles one case, but it doesn't resolve the broader issue of using copyrighted works to train AI models.

news.title: Trump’s latest AI czar has already resigned
news.description: The director role for the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) has become a revolving door since David Sacks left his position as czar.

news.title: AI minister role boosted but tech department axed in Burnham shake-up
news.description: Kanishka Narayan will attend cabinet - but no longer have the leadership of a technology secretary.

news.title: Ofcom unable to take further legal action against suicide forum
news.description: The regulator said it had "no further legal routes available" under the Online Safety Act.

news.title: China's Moonshot AI claims Kimi K3 can rival OpenAI and Anthropic
news.description: The company has unveiled a massive new artificial intelligence model it says can take on top American firms.

news.title: Nvidia Wants to Own Every Chip Inside AI Data Centers
news.description: Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform combines CPUs and GPUs into a single system, reflecting the company’s growing ambition to power every layer of AI infrastructure.
